searchText: Friendly reminder that after a week off, our weekly 4844 call is back tomorrow 15:30 UTC 😄 Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/716 <gakonst> QQ, given no proof of custody-like game, is there something in the 4844 EIP which demands that nodes actually store and don’t immediately prune blobs? <gakonst> Also recall Peter may have mentioned a new txpool w/ an on-disk impl for storing blob txs, was there a doc for that? Yes: https://gist.github.com/karalabe/e1c4e4c2a226926498cc9816d383cecb The only thing would be you may have peering issues if you do this. In lighthouse for example we will ban peers that aren't able to serve blobs over rpc in during data availability period Was today's Implementers’ Call recorded? Yep - recording here: https://youtu.be/O1LLyKIMHUM
